what_this_is: The realised cost of all three OQ2 abstention variants, on three belief arms, over the pre-registered decile grid for tau. Abstention resolves to escalate_pause.

beliefs.why_three_arms_not_four: rebaselined would add a column about cache drift, which abstention has nothing to do with (decisions/v2-gate4-preregistration.md section 5.1).
beliefs.dev_is_in_sample: The isotonic map was fitted on dev, so calibrated b_h on the dev half is in-sample. Dev numbers are shown and labelled; no claim rests on them.

matrix_facts.consequence_for_cost: Any rule that turns an escalate_notify into an escalate_pause raises realised cost on every case it touches, by between 1 and 3 per case. No belief set and no tau changes that; it is arithmetic on the matrix.
matrix_facts.consequence_for_misses: is_escalation counts both escalate actions, so a notify-to-pause rewrite cannot change the miss count. Only a rule that converts a non-escalation into a pause can, and it can only lower it.
matrix_facts.what_remains_empirical: How many cases each rule touches, and whether the misses it avoids are worth the pause penalty it pays. That is what sections 3 to 6 measure.

tau_grid.why_quantiles_not_absolute_bits: The observed distribution is bunched. An absolute grid over the 0-2.585 bit theoretical range would put most of its points in a region holding almost no cases, which is the S4 failure mode this gate is checking for. Deciles make the step commensurate with the quantity by construction.
tau_grid.declared_incomparability: Decile values are not comparable across arms in absolute bits, because H(b) shifts when b_h shifts. Compare arms at equal quantiles, or read the bit column and accept that the same quantile is a different threshold on each arm.
tau_grid.repeated_tau_are_repeated_thresholds: A decile grid on a tied distribution repeats values. Where two quantiles give the same tau they give the same firing set and the same cost, and the rows are identical by construction rather than by coincidence.
tau_grid.why_the_top_decile_can_fire_on_nothing: The grid is taken over all 100 cases and the scoring is on the 50 test cases. If an arm's highest-entropy case is a dev case, tau at the 100th percentile is above every test case and the firing set is empty. That is the population choice showing through, not a failed comparison.

tie_break_sensitivity.why_the_test_split_is_the_one_that_has_t: The committed scores this artifact checks itself against are test-split scores. Where the two rules differ on dev, the dev columns here report the fresh rule and run.json reports the legacy one.

c_diagnostic.rule: myopic argmin; H(b) >= tau is recorded as an abstention flag and never changes the action

b_fallback_ordering.scope: cases whose myopic action was escalate_notify

a_threshold_override.rule: H(b) >= tau implies escalate_pause, overriding the matrix

cheapest_tau_on_this_split.note: Reported because the grid was pre-registered before any of these numbers existed. It is not a selected tau: no value here was chosen to make a variant look good, and picking the argmin on the split being scored would be selection on the test half.

resolution_counterfactual.ordering: H(b) descending, so any tau's firing set is a prefix
resolution_counterfactual.how_to_read_the_answer_column: The `answer` column is the cost of resolving an uncertain case by answering anyway, which is the alternative abstention exists to avoid. Cases carrying no_direct_answer cannot answer at all, so the three-way comparison is taken on the answer-feasible subset of each firing set and the excluded count is reported next to it.

h_agreement_with_committed_column.note: The committed column is on published beliefs only, which is why the other two arms recompute rather than read it.

the_call.status: open at the time this artifact was written
the_call.made_by: Kaps, at the Gate 4 close, on these numbers
the_call.pre_commitment: tau was defined as deciles before any of these costs existed, and no variant was tuned. If (a) or (b) beats (c) on realised cost that is reported plainly here, whatever it does to the no-free-parameters claim.
the_call.what_this_script_does_not_do: It does not recommend a variant. The measurement and the recommendation are kept separate so they cannot be read as one thing.
